chunks: And by his chain, he said, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
The most evil of the people are the people who fault the enjoining of the good and the forbidding of the evil.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the most evil people according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) identifies a specific group as the 'most evil' of people: those who criticize or find fault with the fundamental Islamic practice of enjoining good (al-amr bi-l-ma'ruf) and forbidding evil (al-nahy 'an al-munkar). This highlights the importance of these two pillars in maintaining social and religious integrity. In Shia scholarship, this hadith underscores that neglecting or mocking this duty is not merely a minor oversight but a sign of spiritual decay, linking the community's moral health directly to the active practice of these commands.
